computer_v1.name: Original DIY Computer
computer_v1.desc: An 8-bit stack-based computer processor designed to support programming in Reverse Polish Notation (RPN). I got the idea for this from my 1989 HP 48SX calculator which also uses RPN. It has: 64k of heap memory, 64k x 16 bit instruction flash, a 32 x 32 display, a hardware call stack, and basic binary operations.

rusty_logic.name: Rusty Logic
rusty_logic.desc: I was inspired to create this program after making a crude logic simulator/animator in TS for MotionCanvas for my DIY computer presentation. It is written in Rust and is the program I used to design the 2nd version of my computer.
